summary: Xiao-I Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting that it regained full compliance with Nasdaq's continued listing standards. The company had received deficiency notices in December 2025 for failing to maintain a minimum bid price of $1.00 per share and a minimum market value of publicly held shares of $15.0 million. Nasdaq confirmed compliance was regained on April 23, 2026 (market value) and May 29, 2026 (bid price). No terms, deal structure, or special-situation event is present. This is a routine compliance update with no actionable risk-arb angle.
